 Order

05. 1.
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant when the matter is called.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special G.R. Case No.02 of 2023, pending before the Court of learned ADJ-cum-P.O., Special Court (POCSO), Sundargarh, arising out of Bandamunda P.S. Case No.159 of 2022, for commission of alleged offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3)/323/506 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act and Section 9 of the Prohibition of the Child Marriage Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned A.D.J.-cum-cum-P.O., Special Court (POCSO), Sundargarh by order dated 01.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 03.02.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 28.02.2023, his further continuance in custody is unwarranted.

5. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. Statement of the victim.
6.

This matter came up before this Court on 04.08.2023 on which date, learned counsel Ms. S. Patel engaged by the DLSA appeared for the victim and taking note of her submission, this Court directed Goutam @ Gautam Kumar vs State Of Odisha & Another ....

the Investigating Officer to cause an enquiry and submit a report regarding threat perception.
7. For better appreciation, paragraph-2 & 3 thereof the order dated 04.08.2023 is extracted hereunder:-
"2. Learned counsel Ms. Sarita Patel engaged by the DLSA has appeared for the victim.
She submits that because of threat perception, the victim is not able to execute a vakalatnama.

3. The Investigating Officer is directed to cause an enquiry regarding threat perception and submit a report in this regard through learned Standing Counsel, Mr.
Praharaj by 10.08.2023."
8.
The report of the IIC, submitted through the learned counsel for the State, Mr. Gaya is taken on record.
9. Considering the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application at this stage.
10. Liberty is granted to the petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin after examination of the victim.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. The SP Sundargarh is called upon to ensure that the victim and her family member are not threatened in any manner and steps be taken to instill a sense of confidence in them.
13. Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State, Mr. Gaya for compliance.
